Name: Eskbl's Wizard Portrait
Author: eskbl
Description:
Inspired by all the cool portrait mods out there. I wanted to try my hand at drawing the wizard :--)

Intended to be used with mods that let you romance the wizard.
I'm personally using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romancable Rasmodius[/url] mod (specifically the SVE compatible version), but I assume it'll work with the Looking for Love mod as well.

[b]UPDATE:[/b]
- Now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url] (Romancable Rasmodius Redux Revamped SVE Required)!! Includes a full 32 portraits with new expressions. If you are using this version, make sure to have RRRR's prerequisite mods installed.

- Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22691?tab=description&BH=3]Wizard Sprites for Eskbl's Portraits[/url] (works with SVE and RRRR) made by VampireCowboi !!

[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]

[b]How to Install:

[/b][list]
[*]Unzip and move 'Eskbl' folder into 'Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits'
( It'll look like: 'Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Eskbl' )[*]Start game and talk to the Wizard, once his dialogue box is open, press 'P' to toggle portraits.
[/list]

Enjoy! (n___n)/

[i]You can also find me on [url=https://twitter.com/eskbl]Twitter.[/url][/i]
